plywood.heading: Plywood that matches the job — MR for interiors, BWP for water.
plywood.intro: Plywood is still the backbone of Indian interiors — layered hardwood veneers bonded under pressure for strength that particle boards can't match. We stock Duroply's two workhorses: MR (Moisture Resistant) plywood for furniture, wardrobes and partitions in normal indoor conditions, and BWP (Boiling Water Proof) plywood for kitchens, bathrooms and anywhere water is a daily reality. Both are IS-certified and available in bulk from our Ahmedabad warehouse.

faq.q: What is MR grade plywood used for?
faq.a: MR (Moisture Resistant) grade plywood is used for interior applications such as furniture, wardrobes, bed frames, shelving, and wall partitions. It offers good resistance to moisture in normal indoor conditions.

faq.q: What is BWP plywood and where is it used?
faq.a: BWP (Boiling Water Proof) plywood is a high-grade plywood bonded with phenol formaldehyde resin, making it highly resistant to water and moisture. It is commonly used in kitchens, bathrooms, exterior furniture, and marine applications where exposure to water is frequent.

faq.q: What is the difference between BWP and MR plywood?
faq.a: BWP plywood uses phenol formaldehyde resin and can withstand boiling water for extended periods, making it suitable for wet areas. MR (Moisture Resistant) plywood uses urea formaldehyde resin and is resistant to moisture but not suitable for direct water exposure.

faq.q: Is MR plywood suitable for kitchen cabinets?
faq.a: MR plywood can be used for kitchen cabinets in areas with moderate moisture. However, for areas directly exposed to water such as sink cabinets, BWP plywood is recommended for better water resistance.

faq.q: What sizes and thicknesses are available?
faq.a: Duroply plywood comes in standard 8 × 4 ft sheets, in thicknesses from 4 mm to 25 mm. Custom size requirements can be arranged on bulk orders — message us on WhatsApp with your cutting list.

faq.q: Can I buy plywood in bulk in Ahmedabad?
faq.a: Yes — Ananta Corporation supplies Duroply MR and BWP plywood in bulk across Ahmedabad and Gujarat, with ready stock, competitive bulk pricing and fast delivery for interior designers, builders and contractors.

faq.q: What is interior grade MDF used for?
faq.a: Interior grade MDF is used for furniture, kitchen cabinets, wardrobes, decorative wall panels, shelving, and display units. Its smooth surface makes it ideal for painting, laminating, and veneering.

faq.q: What is the difference between MDF and plywood?
faq.a: MDF is made from compressed wood fibres and has a smooth, uniform surface ideal for painted finishes. Plywood is made from layered wood veneers and offers greater structural strength. MDF is preferred for decorative work, while plywood is better for load-bearing applications.

faq.q: Can exterior MDF be used outdoors?
faq.a: Exterior grade MDF is designed for semi-outdoor and high-humidity areas such as covered balconies, bathrooms, and exterior wall panelling. For fully exposed outdoor applications, additional protective coating is recommended.

faq.q: What is HDHMR board?
faq.a: HDHMR (High Density High Moisture Resistant) board is an engineered wood panel that combines high density for structural strength with moisture-resistant resins. It is widely used for modular kitchens, wardrobes, and commercial furniture.

faq.q: Is HDHMR better than plywood for kitchens?
faq.a: HDHMR boards offer a smoother surface, better screw-holding capacity, and consistent quality compared to commercial plywood. For modular kitchen carcasses, HDHMR is often preferred due to its moisture resistance and uniform density.

faq.q: What thicknesses of MDF are available?
faq.a: We stock Action Tesa interior MDF from 1.9 mm to 25 mm, exterior MDF from 3.3 mm to 25 mm, and HDHMR from 3 mm to 25 mm — all in standard 8 × 4 ft sheets. Contact us for bulk availability.

faq.q: What is HMR board and where is it used?
faq.a: HMR (High Moisture Resistant) board is a particle board treated with moisture-resistant resin, making it suitable for kitchens, bathrooms, and humid environments. It is commonly used for modular kitchen carcasses, wardrobe interiors, and commercial furniture.

faq.a: HMR board is a standard-density particle board with moisture resistance. HDHMR board has higher density, offering better screw-holding strength and structural rigidity in addition to moisture resistance. HDHMR is preferred for heavy-duty applications.

body: Enquiry form: when you send an enquiry we collect your name, phone number, email address, and any details you include about your product interest, quantity and project.
Chat assistant: if you use the on-site chat, we process the messages you type, and — if you choose to continue a conversation — the email address you verify.
WhatsApp: tapping a "Get Price on WhatsApp" button opens WhatsApp with a pre-filled message; any conversation there is governed by WhatsApp's own terms and privacy policy.
We do not collect payment information through this website, and we do not use invasive tracking or sell advertising.

sections.heading: How we use your information
body: We use the details you share solely to respond to your enquiry — to send pricing, check stock, arrange samples or delivery, and follow up on your request. If you have asked us to, we may contact you about related products or availability.
We do not sell, rent or trade your personal information.

sections.heading: Sharing and service providers
body: Your information is shared only with the service providers that make this website work — for example, our hosting platform and the email service that delivers enquiry notifications and verification codes. These providers process data on our behalf and are not permitted to use it for their own purposes.

sections.heading: Retention and your rights
body: We keep enquiry details only as long as needed to handle your request and any resulting business relationship. You can ask us at any time to access, correct or delete the information we hold about you — email info@anantacorporation.com and we will action it promptly.

sections.heading: Contact
body: Questions about this policy or your data: email info@anantacorporation.com, call +91 83200 52838, or write to Ananta Corporation, 293/2, Godown No. 17, Nanukaka Estate, Opp. Sub Station, Pirana Road, Piplaj, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382405.

body: This website is operated by Ananta Corporation (GSTIN 24ACDFA7104Q1ZB), Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. By using the site you accept these terms. If you do not agree with them, please do not use the site.

sections.heading: Product information
body: We work hard to keep product descriptions, specifications, sizes and certifications accurate, and they reflect manufacturer-published information for the brands we supply. Specifications can change at the manufacturer's end — always confirm the exact specification, grade and size with our team before placing an order.
Product and brand names (Duroply, DURODOOR, Action TESA, Tenon Smart Lock and others) belong to their respective owners; we use them as an authorized supplier/distributor of those products.

sections.heading: Pricing and quotations
body: We do not publish prices on this website. Pricing is provided on request — via WhatsApp or the enquiry form — and reflects current market rates, quantities and delivery location. A quotation is valid only for the period stated in it and is subject to stock availability.

sections.heading: Orders and delivery
body: Orders, payment terms and delivery timelines are agreed per transaction at the time of confirmation. Delivery is arranged as per location and availability. Please inspect goods on delivery and raise any discrepancy with our team immediately.

sections.heading: Intellectual property and acceptable use
body: The content of this website — text, layout and design — belongs to Ananta Corporation unless otherwise noted (product imagery and décor swatches belong to their respective brands). You may not scrape, republish or use the content for competing commercial purposes without permission, and you agree not to misuse the site's forms or chat.

sections.heading: Liability
body: This website is provided on an as-is basis. While we keep information current, we accept no liability for decisions made solely on the basis of website content without confirmation from our team. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited under applicable law.

sections.heading: Governing law and contact
body: These terms are governed by the laws of India, with courts at Ahmedabad, Gujarat having jurisdiction. Questions: info@anantacorporation.com · +91 83200 52838.
